title: Content Creator

steps: Post consistently for months or years
Earn through brand deals, ads, affiliate links, courses or your own products

rows.label: Most creators
rows.value: Little or nothing; only ~8–10% of Indian creators earn a meaningful income

rows.label: Mid-sized creators
rows.value: Irregular income from brand deals (e.g., one Kolkata creator shared earning ₹3.06 lakh from 5 brand deals in a month)

rows.label: Macro creators
rows.value: ~₹20 lakh to ₹1.5 crore a year; mega creators more

pros: Almost zero cost to start: a phone and internet
Creative freedom and being your own boss
Creator jobs are growing too (Indeed: creator-related postings up ~919% from 2020 to early 2026), with roles like editors, managers and strategists
cons: Power-law income: a tiny fraction earn most of the money
Unstable month to month; one algorithm change can wipe out reach
Mental-health strain: comments, comparison, pressure to post constantly
No salary, PF or paid leave; you're a business, with taxes and contracts

visual.of: Indian creators earn a meaningful income

sceneIdeas: A brand offers ₹15,000 for a product you don't like
A reel goes viral and you can't repeat it
Family asks when you'll get a "real job"

sources.label: ₹3.06 lakh from 5 brand deals, Kolkata creator (Business Today)
